summary: Example of with_random_choice choosing one of several messages.

answer_card.title: random_choice example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item }}"
  with_random_choice:
    - "go through the door"
    - "drink from the goblet"
    - "press the red button"
    - "do nothing"
```
